holdCodes.text: Survival over 18 minutes (1.15 × the harness p99).
Late evidence: the run reached the server more than 20 minutes after it could have ended (a banked or long-paused session).
At least 5 fast pairs (flaps ≤ 2 ticks apart) and at least 1% of intervals. Humans can make these with two keys or a worn mouse: never disqualify on H4 alone.
Machine-regular timing: one interval ≥ 45% of all, a run of ≥ 25 equal intervals, or interval entropy under 3 bits.
At least 85 flaps per minute over at least 3 minutes (scripts fly at 90-95).
